use_cases.name: Build a consented talent pool and nurture it until a role opens
use_cases.goal: Keep past and prospective candidates engaged in talent pools through consent-based campaigns so that approved requisitions can be filled from warm candidates first.

stakeholders.interest: Hears only about relevant roles, on channels they agreed to, and can withdraw consent at any time.
Gets a shortlist of already-interested candidates within days of the requisition being approved.
Sees that candidate personal data is held only with valid consent under the DPDP Act 2023 (to be validated by Legal).

use_cases.trigger: A recruiter creates a talent pool for a hard-to-fill skill or schedules a nurture campaign.
preconditions: Candidate records carry consent with purpose, channel and expiry date.
Message templates for each campaign language are approved.
Channel opt-ins for email and the business messaging channel are recorded per candidate.
postconditions_success: Pool members have an engagement stage and a full contact history.
Engaged members are moved into a requisition's pipeline without re-entering data.
postconditions_failure: Candidates without valid consent are never messaged and are anonymised on expiry.

main_flow.action: Creates the pool CNC setters – Pune and Bengaluru with criteria: 3+ years on vertical machining centres, willing to work shifts.
Suggests members from past finalists, referrals and career-site sign-ups whose consent is valid, and marks duplicates.
Adds 85 suggested candidates to the pool.
Builds a 6-week nurture campaign: plant tour video, Chakan Works open-house invite and a job alert, in Marathi and English.
Sends each message only on channels the candidate consented to and includes an unsubscribe option in every message.
Records deliveries, opens and replies and moves responders to the stage Engaged.
Replies that she is interested and updates her current notice period in the candidate portal.
Matches the pool to a newly approved requisition and moves 12 engaged candidates into its pipeline.
Twelve months after a candidate's last interaction, requests re-consent and anonymises the record if none is given within 30 days.

alternate_flows.condition: A candidate has consented to email but not to the business messaging channel.
steps: Platform sends the campaign by email only and records the channel restriction.

exception_flows.condition: A suggested candidate is already active in another requisition's pipeline.
exception_flows.handling: The candidate is added to the pool but flagged as in process and excluded from campaigns.
All campaigns stop at once and the record is erased or anonymised within the configured period.

exception_flows.condition: A template has no approved version for a recipient's language.
exception_flows.handling: That recipient is held back and the recruiter is asked to approve a translation.

nfrs: Consent withdrawal stops all outbound messages within 5 minutes.
Campaign sends are throttled to the per-channel rate limit configured for the tenant.

user_stories.want: to fill a talent pool from past finalists who still have valid consent
user_stories.so_that: I can approach warm candidates before advertising

acceptance.given: 312 past candidates match the CNC setter criteria and 41 have expired consent
acceptance.then: 271 candidates are suggested and none with expired consent appears

acceptance.given: a suggested candidate is active in requisition REQ-2026-118
acceptance.when: I add her to the pool
acceptance.then: she is flagged as in process and excluded from the campaign

user_stories.want: to choose which channels a recruiter may use and to stop all contact in one step
user_stories.so_that: I control how my data is used

acceptance.given: I consented to email only
acceptance.when: the Chakan Works open-house campaign runs
acceptance.then: I receive it by email and nothing on the messaging channel

acceptance.given: I select unsubscribe from any message
acceptance.then: no further campaign message reaches me after 5 minutes

user_stories.want: engaged pool candidates offered to me as soon as my requisition is approved
user_stories.so_that: I can start interviews within the week

acceptance.given: my requisition for 4 CNC setters at Chakan Works is approved
acceptance.then: 12 engaged candidates appear in my pipeline with their nurture history

acceptance.given: a matched candidate's notice period is 90 days
acceptance.then: the notice period is shown on the candidate card

use_cases.name: Run a bulk hiring drive from registration to batch onboarding
use_cases.goal: Hire a large frontline or campus cohort through a scheduled drive with mass assessment, batch offers and batch onboarding.

stakeholders.interest: Gets 120 operators on the floor at Medchal Works on the planned joining date.
Registers on a phone, gets a clear slot and hears the outcome quickly.
Approves one batch of offers against the approved headcount and budget.

use_cases.trigger: A requisition for a large cohort is approved, for example 120 machine operators for the Medchal Works expansion.
preconditions: The requisition is approved with headcount and offer budget.
Assessment templates for aptitude and trade skill are published.
Offer and onboarding templates for the grade are approved.
postconditions_success: Accepted candidates form an onboarding cohort with a common joining date and induction plan.
Drive metrics show registrations, attendance, pass rate, offers and acceptances.
postconditions_failure: Unfilled positions remain open on the requisition with the waitlist preserved.

main_flow.action: Creates a drive on 2026-12-12 at Medchal Works linked to the requisition, with three slots of 40 candidates each.
Publishes a registration link and QR code; candidates register on a phone in Telugu, Hindi or English and pick a slot.
Checks candidates in at the gate by scanning their QR code and sighting an identity document.
Takes the 30-minute aptitude and trade test on a site tablet.
Scores the tests and lists candidates above the cut-off for interview.
Panels record scorecards on tablets; the platform ranks candidates by combined score.
Selects the top 120 and a waitlist of 20, and generates a batch offer from the grade template.
Approves the batch offer through the approval engine within the requisition budget.
Releases offers by SMS, the business messaging channel and email, and tracks e-signed acceptances.
Creates an onboarding cohort for accepted candidates with joining date, induction and document collection tasks.

alternate_flows.condition: The drive is a campus drive at an industrial training institute.
steps: Recruiter uploads the institute's student list; students confirm registration.
Offers are issued as conditional on final results.

alternate_flows.condition: Acceptances are 104 of 120 by the deadline.
steps: Platform proposes the next 16 waitlisted candidates in rank order.
Recruiter confirms, and offers are released after the same approval.

exception_flows.condition: A candidate registers twice with the same mobile number.
exception_flows.handling: The registrations are merged and the candidate keeps the earlier slot.
The candidate is offered the next slot with space.

exception_flows.condition: The batch total exceeds the approved offer budget.
exception_flows.handling: Approval cannot be submitted until the batch is reduced or the budget revised.

nfrs: Registration handles 2,000 sign-ups in an hour from mobile networks.
Gate check-in completes within 5 s per candidate.

user_stories.want: to schedule a drive with fixed slots and phone registration

acceptance.given: a drive with three slots of 40
acceptance.then: slot 1 is shown as full and slot 2 is offered

acceptance.given: a candidate registers again with the same mobile number
acceptance.then: it is merged with the earlier registration

user_stories.want: to issue one batch of offers and backfill declines from the waitlist

acceptance.given: 120 offers are approved and 104 are accepted by 2026-12-20
acceptance.then: the next 16 waitlisted candidates are proposed in rank order for my confirmation

acceptance.given: I confirm the 16
acceptance.then: 16 new offers are released

user_stories.want: accepted candidates to arrive as one onboarding cohort
user_stories.so_that: induction and document checks are planned for a single joining day

acceptance.given: 120 acceptances with joining date 2027-01-04
acceptance.then: each joiner has induction and document tasks due before 2027-01-04

acceptance.given: a joiner has not uploaded an address proof by 2027-01-02
acceptance.then: the joiner and Plant HR are reminded

use_cases.name: Assign an online assessment and shortlist on score
use_cases.goal: Assess candidates for aptitude, trade skill or language through online tests with appropriate proctoring and shortlist on score with recruiter confirmation.

stakeholders.interest: Takes a fair test, can request reasonable accommodation and knows how proctoring data is used.
Interviews only candidates who meet the skill threshold.

use_cases.trigger: A recruiter assigns an assessment to candidates at a pipeline stage.
preconditions: The assessment template is published with sections, time limits, cut-off score and proctoring mode.
Candidates have consented to the chosen proctoring mode.
postconditions_success: Scores and section results are on the candidate record and qualifying candidates are moved forward after recruiter confirmation.
postconditions_failure: Proctoring flags never reject a candidate automatically; they await human review.

main_flow.action: Assigns the template CNC operator screen: 20-minute aptitude, 20-minute G-code reading and 10-minute Hindi reading.
Selects the proctoring mode: periodic camera snapshots with consent, locked browser, or supervised test centre.
Sends each candidate a unique link valid for 72 hours with the proctoring notice.
Takes the test on a phone or laptop; answers are saved after every question.
Scores objective sections and records proctoring events such as tab switches or a second face in a snapshot.
Proposes a shortlist of candidates at or above the cut-off of 60%.
Reviews proctoring flags, clears or upholds each with a note, and confirms the shortlist.
Moves confirmed candidates to the interview stage and informs the others of the outcome.

alternate_flows.condition: A candidate requests extra time for a declared disability.
steps: Platform extends that candidate's timer only.

exception_flows.handling: The candidate resumes from the last saved answer with the remaining time.
The candidate is offered a supervised test centre slot instead.
The candidate is marked not attempted and the recruiter may reissue once.

nfrs: Answers are saved within 1 s of selection.
Proctoring snapshots are deleted 90 days after the requisition closes.

user_stories.want: a shortlist proposed from test scores that I confirm
user_stories.so_that: I screen hundreds of applicants quickly without losing judgement

acceptance.given: 40 candidates finish the CNC operator screen with cut-off 60%
acceptance.then: the 23 candidates scoring 60% or more are proposed for my confirmation

acceptance.given: a candidate scoring 72% has a second-face proctoring flag
acceptance.when: I uphold the flag with a note
acceptance.then: the candidate is excluded and the note is kept with the attempt

user_stories.want: to resume my test if my connection drops
user_stories.so_that: a network problem does not cost me the opportunity

acceptance.given: I have answered 14 questions with 11 minutes left
acceptance.when: my connection drops and I reopen the link
acceptance.then: I resume at question 15 with 11 minutes remaining

acceptance.given: I declared a disability and extra time was approved
acceptance.then: my timer shows 25% more time than standard

use_cases.name: Engage, train and convert apprentices and trainees
use_cases.goal: Manage apprentices and trainees from engagement through stipend, training milestones and statutory records to a recorded conversion outcome.

stakeholders.interest: As an apprentice, receives the stipend on time, knows the training plan and gets a completion record.
Holds the apprenticeship contracts, registers and returns required under the Apprentices Act, 1961 (to be validated by Legal).
Trains apprentices against defined milestones and assesses them fairly.
Decides conversions to permanent roles against open positions.

use_cases.trigger: HR operations engages an apprentice batch, for example 30 fitter and machinist apprentices at Chakan Works.
preconditions: Apprentice trades, durations and stipend tables are configured for the entity (to be validated by Legal).
The establishment's apprentice engagement limits are configured in the rule pack.
An apprentice payroll group exists separate from employee payroll.
postconditions_success: Each apprentice has a registered contract, stipend history, milestone record and a recorded outcome: converted, completed without offer or discontinued.
postconditions_failure: Engagements beyond the configured limit are blocked.
Discontinued apprentices have the reason and date recorded and stipend stops.

main_flow.action: Creates 30 apprentice engagements at Chakan Works in fitter and machinist trades, each for 12 months, with stipend from the configured table.
Checks the batch against the establishment's configured apprentice limits.
Records the contract registration reference from the statutory portal for each apprentice.
Assigns the training plan: 2 months basic training, then on-the-job rotation across turning, milling and assembly.
Assesses each apprentice at each milestone and records the result.
Raises the monthly stipend for each apprentice into the apprentice payroll group based on attendance.
At the end of the term, generates the completion record and lists apprentices eligible for conversion.
Approves conversion offers for selected apprentices against open operator positions.
Records each outcome and, for conversions, starts the hire into the employee population with prior apprenticeship linked.

alternate_flows.condition: The engagement is a graduate trainee rather than a statutory apprentice.
steps: HR selects the trainee scheme; statutory contract registration is not required.
A trainee stipend table and 6-month plan are applied.

exception_flows.condition: The batch would exceed the configured apprentice limit.
exception_flows.handling: The excess engagements are blocked and the limit and current count are shown.

exception_flows.condition: An apprentice fails a milestone assessment twice.
exception_flows.handling: The manager and HR are prompted to agree an extension or discontinuation.

exception_flows.condition: An apprentice has unexplained absence above the configured threshold.
exception_flows.handling: Stipend is computed on actual attendance and Plant HR is alerted.

nfrs: Apprentice records are retained for the period configured in the rule pack after completion.
Stipend inputs are raised within the same payroll cut-off as employee inputs.

user_stories.want: to engage an apprentice batch within the establishment's configured limit
user_stories.so_that: we stay within statutory engagement rules

acceptance.given: the configured limit allows 32 more apprentices at Chakan Works
acceptance.then: all 30 are created and the remaining capacity shows 2

acceptance.given: the configured limit allows 2 more apprentices
acceptance.then: 3 engagements are blocked with the limit shown

user_stories.want: as an apprentice, to see my milestones and stipend each month
user_stories.so_that: I know how I am progressing and what I will be paid

acceptance.given: I am apprentice A-2026-014 and passed basic training on 2026-08-31
acceptance.then: basic training shows Passed and the milling rotation shows In progress

acceptance.given: I attended 24 of 26 working days in October 2026
acceptance.then: my stipend reflects 24 attended days

user_stories.want: to approve conversions of completing apprentices to operator roles
user_stories.so_that: we retain trained people against open positions

acceptance.given: 6 apprentices complete on 2026-12-31 and 4 operator positions are open
acceptance.then: I can approve at most 4 conversions

acceptance.given: I approve the conversion of apprentice A-2026-009
acceptance.then: a hire is started with the apprenticeship record linked

use_cases.name: Match a mentee with a mentor and track outcomes
use_cases.goal: Match employees with suitable mentors by skills, goals, language and site, log sessions and measure programme outcomes.

stakeholders.interest: Finds a mentor who can help reach a stated goal, such as moving into a shift supervisor role.
As a mentor, controls capacity and keeps session notes private to the pair.
Sees programme outcomes in aggregate to improve the programme.

use_cases.trigger: An employee joins a mentoring programme and states a development goal.
preconditions: The programme is open with an opted-in mentor pool, each mentor having skills, languages and capacity.
The employee has a skills profile.
postconditions_success: An active pairing exists with agreed goals, cadence and logged sessions, and outcomes are recorded at 3 and 6 months.
postconditions_failure: Unmatched mentees remain on a waitlist and HR is told which skills lack mentors.

main_flow.action: Joins the programme with the goal Become a shift supervisor within 18 months and selects Hindi and Marathi as languages.
Ranks mentors by skill overlap with the goal, language, site and free capacity, and shows the top 3 with the reasons.
Selects a mentor and sends a request.
Accepts the request as mentor.
Creates the pairing with goals, monthly cadence and a 6-month term, and schedules the first session.
Logs each session with date, duration and topics; notes stay visible only to the pair.
Prompts both at 3 and 6 months to rate progress against the goal.
Views programme metrics in aggregate: active pairs, session frequency and goal progress.

steps: Platform frees the request and shows the mentee the next ranked mentors.

exception_flows.condition: No mentor has free capacity with the needed skills.
exception_flows.handling: The mentee is waitlisted and HR sees the uncovered skill.

exception_flows.condition: A metric slice covers fewer than 5 pairs.
exception_flows.handling: The slice is suppressed in HR reports.

nfrs: Session notes are excluded from HR reports, search and agent tools.

user_stories.want: to see three suitable mentors with the reasons they were suggested
user_stories.so_that: I can choose someone who fits my goal

acceptance.given: E1021 at Peenya Works sets the goal shift supervisor with Hindi as preferred language
acceptance.then: three mentors appear, each with matched skills, language and free capacity

acceptance.given: a suggested mentor has capacity 0
acceptance.then: that mentor is not shown

user_stories.want: as a mentor, to keep session notes private to my mentee and me

acceptance.given: I have logged 4 sessions with E1021
acceptance.then: HR sees 4 sessions counted but none of the notes

acceptance.given: my capacity is 2 and I have 2 active mentees
acceptance.when: a new request is sent to me
acceptance.then: the request is not allowed and the mentee sees other suggestions

use_cases.name: Author multilingual micro-learning and deliver it to plant workers offline
use_cases.goal: Author short learning content, publish it in plant languages after human review of any machine translation, and deliver it through a personalised feed with offline viewing and virtual classrooms.

stakeholders.interest: Learns in their own language in short sessions, including where the plant has weak connectivity.
Sees team completion of mandatory safety modules.
Has completion evidence for safety training at each site.

use_cases.trigger: An L&D author in HR operations creates a module, or a mandatory module is assigned to an audience.
preconditions: Authoring rights are granted to the author for the target sites.
Translation reviewers are named for each target language.
Workers have the mobile app or access to a site kiosk.
postconditions_success: The module is published in every reviewed language and completions are recorded as xAPI statements on each learner's record.
postconditions_failure: Languages without reviewer approval are not published.

main_flow.action: Creates the module Lockout-tagout in five minutes with a 3-minute video, two cards and a 3-question quiz.
Drafts Hindi, Marathi, Tamil and Telugu translations as proposals only.
Sends each draft to the named language reviewer, who edits and approves it.
Publishes approved languages to maintenance technicians at Chakan and Oragadam Works as mandatory, due in 14 days.
Ranks each learner's feed by mandatory due date, role, skill gaps and language preference.
Downloads the module on the mobile app at the hostel and completes it offline.
Syncs progress when the device reconnects and records the completion as an xAPI statement.
Schedules a virtual classroom for supervisors with joining link, roster and attendance capture.
Views team completion and overdue learners for mandatory modules.

steps: Worker completes the module on the canteen kiosk after badge sign-in.

exception_flows.condition: The Telugu reviewer has not approved by the publish date.
exception_flows.handling: Telugu is withheld; learners preferring Telugu receive the Hindi version with a notice.

exception_flows.condition: The feed would recommend a learning path the worker already holds.
An offline completion syncs after the due date but was completed before it.
exception_flows.handling: The completion is recorded with the device timestamp and is not marked overdue.

nfrs: Offline modules play on low-end Android devices with up to 30 days between syncs.

user_stories.want: machine-drafted translations that I can send to reviewers before publishing
user_stories.so_that: workers get accurate safety content in their language quickly

acceptance.given: the module is authored in English
acceptance.then: drafts for Hindi, Marathi, Tamil and Telugu are created with status Awaiting review

acceptance.given: only Hindi and Marathi are approved on the publish date
acceptance.then: only Hindi, Marathi and English are released and Tamil and Telugu stay in review

user_stories.want: to download a module and complete it without network
user_stories.so_that: I can learn in the hostel where the signal is weak

acceptance.given: E1066 downloaded Lockout-tagout in five minutes
acceptance.then: the app stores the completion locally with the timestamp

acceptance.given: her phone reconnects on 2026-11-12, after the due date of 2026-11-11
acceptance.then: the completion is recorded as on time with the 2026-11-10 timestamp

user_stories.want: to see which of my technicians have not completed mandatory safety learning
user_stories.so_that: I can follow up before the due date

acceptance.given: 18 of 22 technicians have completed the module
acceptance.then: 4 names are listed as pending with the due date

acceptance.given: a technician completes it on the kiosk
acceptance.then: the technician is removed from the pending list
